lines.zh: 肌肉绷紧，骨节咔嚓作响。
lines.en: Muscles tensed, bones creaking.
Skeletal movement in the flesh.

lines.zh: 行于腐肉之上，步履沉重。
lines.en: Step heavy on the carrion.
Stare down prey, eyes ablaze.
Each step crushes decay.
Flesh moves, bones resonate.
Skin taut with each step.
Gait unsteady, like a hell messenger.
Flesh writhes, bones snap.
Flesh body moves slowly.

lines.zh: 空洞的眼窝里，目光死寂。
lines.en: Dead eyes stare blankly.
Flesh still, bones silent.
Flesh stiff, like a statue.
Silent, gaze all around.
Flesh still, waiting for prey.
Deadly stare, eyes ablaze.
Flesh frozen, bones still.
Still, flesh moves.
Silent, gaze fierce.
Flesh still, like a statue.

lines.zh: 骨架在血肉里缓慢重组。
lines.en: Bones slowly reassemble inside the flesh.
A thousand wills fall silent at once.

lines.zh: 蜂巢深处，脉搏缓慢起伏。
lines.en: Deep in the hive, a slow pulse rises and falls.

lines.zh: 筋腱绷紧又松开，像在呼吸。
lines.en: Tendons tense and slacken, as if breathing.

lines.zh: 我在等小兵把血带回巢里。
lines.en: I wait for my spawn to bring blood home.

lines.zh: 密室里的空气都是我的味道。
lines.en: The air of the chamber tastes of me.
Locks on prey, eyes ablaze.

lines.zh: 无数眼窝从血肉缝里转向你。
lines.en: Countless eye sockets turn toward you through the flesh seams.
Dead eyes, lock on prey.

lines.zh: 我半血时，会有东西替我挡刀。
lines.en: At half health, something steps in to take the blade.
Stare down prey, ready to act.

lines.zh: 目光锐利，你在我视野中。
lines.en: Sharp gaze, you in my sight.
Eyes ablaze, nowhere to hide.
Locks on prey, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 目光锐利，锁定你的弱点。
lines.en: Sharp gaze, finding your weakness.
Eyes ablaze, you are locked.
A thousand sockets turn toward you.

lines.zh: 你身上的血味，惊醒了蜂巢。
lines.en: The smell of your blood wakes the hive.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的心跳节奏。
lines.en: I have memorized the rhythm of your heart.

lines.zh: 血肉间的缝隙，全都在看你。
lines.en: Every gap in my flesh is watching you.

lines.zh: 又一个祭品走进了密室。
lines.en: Another offering walks into the chamber.
Rotten flesh, agony!
Tendons snapped, unbearable.
Bone marrow dry, pain to the bone.
Exhausted, too tired.
Wounds everywhere, can't take it.
Weak, almost over.
Aching all over, can't hold on.
Meat damaged, can't hold on.
Bloody mess, excruciating pain.
Exhausted, waiting to die.
Flesh tempts you.
Come, feel my power.

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？这是肉的味道。
lines.en: Smell it. Flesh.

lines.zh: 你的意志很弱，我可以轻易吞噬你。
lines.en: Your will is weak, I can consume you.
Eat the rotten flesh.
Greed makes you resist.
I am your meal.
Feel the power in my flesh.

lines.zh: 你的命运就是成为我的一部分。
lines.en: Your fate is to become part of me.
You cannot escape my allure.
Flesh and sinew twisted into me.

lines.zh: 你的刀陷进我的血肉，拔不出来。
lines.en: Your blade sinks into my flesh and won't come out.
Harder than you think!

lines.zh: 小兵还活着，你伤不到我。
lines.en: My minions live. You can't touch me.
My bones are unbreakable!

lines.zh: 筋腱绷紧，你的刃口卷了。
lines.en: Sinew tightens and the edge of your blade curls.
Stop wasting your attacks.

lines.zh: 我的骨刺抵住你，像一堵墙。
lines.en: My bone spurs brace against you like a wall.

lines.zh: 骨与筋拧成的我，撞得你后退。
lines.en: Bone and sinew made me; my impact drives you back.
I won't fall easily.
Come, let's coexist.

lines.zh: 血肉与骨头，合成一体才有力。
lines.en: Flesh and bone fuse into one strength.

lines.zh: 筋腱和骨头，都听我调度。
lines.en: Sinew and bone answer my call.
Join me, be half of me.
Feel my soul.
You are meant to be with me.

lines.zh: 一起创造更强大的生物。
lines.en: Create stronger beings together.
You are the only one who understands me.

lines.zh: 与我结合，成为新的存在。
lines.en: Combine with me, be a new being.

lines.zh: 你的命运就是与我共生。
lines.en: Your fate is to coexist with me.
Feed on rot, gain strength!
Darkness flows through bones and flesh.
Swallow your pain and despair.
This is my realm, Death之地.

lines.zh: 血肉是我的食物，骨髓是我的饮料！
lines.en: Blood is my food, marrow is my drink.
Bone and flesh, my treasures.
Feed, my great horde!
Blood and bone, my strength source.

lines.zh: 硬肉锻造模板，沉在我骨缝里。
lines.en: The hard-flesh smithing template rests in my bones.

lines.zh: 肉骨与金苹果，都是巢的储备。
lines.en: Meat bones and golden apples, stores of the hive.
Prey acquired, taste pain!
Flesh, mine to claim.
You cannot escape my tendrils.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的灵魂，净化之火！
lines.en: Consume your soul, purifying flame.
The taste of prey, delightful.
Yours to feel pain.
Pain is the only language.
Taste the blood, feel the torment.
Prey falls into my grasp.
Consume souls, feed my growth.

lines.zh: 血牙从地面竖起，围住你。
lines.en: Blood fangs rise from the floor and ring you in.

lines.zh: 十字已画好，只等你的位置。
lines.en: The cross is drawn. Only your place is missing.

lines.zh: 你被吸过来了，脚离了地。
lines.en: You are pulled in, feet off the ground.

lines.zh: 血肉之墙合拢，出路没了。
lines.en: Walls of flesh close. The way out is gone.
Your blood will only make the hive hungrier.

lines.zh: 密室的门，从里面锁上了。
lines.en: The chamber door locks from within.
Bone hands move first. Eyes follow.
I smell fear. Sweeter than blood.
Crosses await, your end.
X binds your soul.
Bone magic controls you.
Feel the cross's weight.
X binds you closer.
Crosses and X, bind your soul.
Taste pain, consumed.
Crosses and X, your end.
Feel the cross's pressure.
X binds your fate.

lines.zh: 十字成形，四角把你钉住。
lines.en: The cross forms; its four points pin you.

lines.zh: X形锁链拉直，快过你的腿。
lines.en: The X chains snap taut, faster than your legs.

lines.zh: 喷出的血雾遮住了你的视线。
lines.en: A spray of blood mist blinds you.
You are being dragged toward my chest.
Bone spikes sprout behind you.

lines.zh: 别转向，每个方向都有牙。
lines.en: Don't turn. Teeth wait in every direction.

lines.zh: 我的筋腱缠上你的手腕。
lines.en: My tendons coil around your wrists.
The pull grows. Hold your ground.
Cross and X close in, alternating.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头摩擦的合唱。
lines.en: You hear a chorus of grinding bone.

lines.zh: 血肉之躯，撕裂你的灵魂！
lines.en: Rip your soul with raw flesh!
Bone cage, let you howl in pain!

lines.zh: 筋腱缠绕，束缚你的意志！
lines.en: Tendons bind, ensnare your will!
Feast upon players, enjoy the meal!
Bloodfang bites, endless agony!
Crusher arrives, skull shatters!
Throwing axeman, blood flows!
X summons, fear spreads!
In Death’s Land, all shall be consumed!
Bone king, your doom comes now!
Blood fangs bite through your armor.
A whip of flesh lashes your face.
A bone fist falls; the floor dips.
Tendons pull and tear you apart.

lines.zh: 在蜂巢密室，集群之脑唤醒我！
lines.en: Awaken in the Hive Room, Brain of the Hive calls me!
Blood and bone, forge my will!
In Death’s Land, I am king!

lines.zh: 腐蚀者的召唤，我来回应！
lines.en: Respawn, Corruption, I am here!
Bone nest, my home!
Born in pain, survival is key!
Bone king, I return!
In Death’s Land, I endure!
Fear and pain, my hymn!
Flesh body, immortal soul!
The Brain of the Cluster is dead. I wake.
The hive chamber begins to shake.
Flesh and bone gather into me.

lines.zh: 死亡之地的意志，现形了。
lines.en: The will of the Deathlands takes form.
A thousand tendons pull taut at once.

lines.zh: 我从祭坛的裂缝里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the crack in the altar.
The air here is mine now.
Bone and meat lift me high.

lines.zh: 密室深处，一个声音开始说话。
lines.en: Deep in the chamber, a voice begins to speak.
The hivemind wakes. Prey is present.
Scalded, unbearable.

lines.zh: 从高处坠下，骨节散了架。
lines.en: Falling from height, my joints come apart.
Water seeps into marrow, can't breathe.
Shrapnel tears flesh, pain to the bone.
Pierced by arrows, unbearable.
Magic corrodes, agony.

lines.zh: 饿得浑身发软，谁靠近都一样。
lines.en: Famished and weak, anyone near will do.
Lightning sears, unbearable.
Void devours, can't hold on.
